# do_FeaturePlot() | Gene expression on dimensional reduction

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Feature plots display continuous values (typically gene expression) on dimensional reduction embeddings.

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_FeaturePlot(sample = sample,
                            features = "CD3D")
p
```

## Multiple features

Plot several genes at once:

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_FeaturePlot(sample = sample,
                            features = c("CD3D", "CD8A", "CD4"))
p
```

## Split by variable

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_FeaturePlot(sample = sample,
                            features = "CD3D",
                            split.by = "seurat_clusters")
p
```
